title: Pecorino and Syrian Quenching Gratin
description: A rich and creamy gratin featuring the flavors of Syria and the tang of pecorino cheese.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the quenching and Syrian together with a pinch of salt.
In a greased 8x8 inch baking dish, make a layer of the quenching mixture.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with pecorino cheese.
Repeat the layers one more time.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the gratin rest for 5 minutes before serving.
